name: LTX-2.5 DIRECT PARALLEL FAST V2
dockerStartCmd: set -Eeuo pipefail; ROOT=/workspace/LTX25-DIRECT; READY="$ROOT/.DIRECT_PARALLEL_FAST_V2_READY"; START="$ROOT/start.sh"; INSTALL="$ROOT/install.sh"; export MASHHAD_START_TS=$(date +%s); if [ -f "$READY" ] && [ -x "$START" ]; then exec "$START"; fi; T=$(mktemp /tmp/ltx25-direct-v2.XXXXXX.sh); curl -fLsS --retry 5 --connect-timeout 30 "$MASHHAD_INSTALL_URL" -o "$T"; bash -n "$T"; mkdir -p "$ROOT"; mv "$T" "$INSTALL"; chmod 700 "$INSTALL"; exec bash "$INSTALL"
readme: Direct-only LTX-2.5 BF16 on the official RunPod PyTorch image. Attach a Network Volume at /workspace. The first Pod installs the official pinned Lightricks runtime and downloads five model files in parallel. Later Pods reuse /workspace/LTX25-DIRECT without reinstalling Python, Torch, dependencies, or models. Exactly five BF16 weights are stored once in /workspace/LTX25-DIRECT/models. INT8 is not enabled.
